PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/Brick#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX ref: <http://ref#>
SELECT ?n ?s WHERE { ?z a brick:Zone ; rdfs:label ?l . ?z ref:hasExternalReference ?e ; ref:hasTimeseriesId ?s . ?e brick:hasSuperclass* brick:OccupancySensor . }

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?z ?l WHERE { ?z rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?l),"basement") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?l),"perimeter"))}
